c74object.name: mqtt.send
c74object.description: Publishes every message it receives to one topic, like send across the network.

discussion.p: Numbers, symbols and lists are sent as text, a dictionary as JSON. With format bytes, integers 0-255 are sent as raw bytes, for devices and tools that read binary payloads. A bang sends an empty message; with retain, the broker then deletes the retained message.
With retain 1, the broker keeps the last message of the topic and sends it to every new subscriber: mqtt.receive gets the current value as soon as it subscribes.
The connection is the mqtt.client with the same name. Messages sent while it is not connected are not published.

objarg.name: client
objarg.digest: Name of the mqtt.client to use

method.name: anything
method.description: Publishes the message as text. dictionary <name> publishes the dictionary as JSON.

method.name: bang
method.description: With retain 1, deletes the retained message of the topic.

attribute.name: topic
attribute.description: The topic to publish to, without + or #.

attribute.name: retain
attribute.description: 1: the broker keeps the last message for new subscribers.

attribute.name: format
attribute.description: text: atoms as text, a dictionary as JSON. bytes: integers 0-255 as raw bytes.
